issue_notes: No. 66: no arms, saltpetre or sulphur appear in the Part I trade tables. All rows are seizures from Part III (Fines and Confiscations), entered under imports because every case is 'concealing/landing contraband imports'.

No. 66: the Part III OCR is badly damaged. Quantities that could not be read are left N/A and flagged; the seizure list may be incomplete, especially for Tientsin, Shanghai and Swatow. Seizure values are not entered because the 'amount realised' is printed per case, not per item.

No. 66: 'Brimstone' in the Canton tables is entered as 'Sulphur (brimstone)'. Vessel flag (British, American, German s.s.) is in the cell comment; it is not the country of origin, so the partner column is 'Not specified'.
